notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus.
description:
Tap Soldevi Adnate sacrificing Lurrus to generate {B}{B}{B}.
On LTB, Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Lurrus to the battlefield.
With Lurrus' ability, recast Kaya's Ghostform onto Lurrus.
